LanguageData.WotF_Site_Ruin_Core.arrivedLetter: You have reached the ancient engineering ruin. Relics of an old glitterworld lie buried beneath the thick concrete, but be careful—the anti-intrusion defenses are still active...\nYou have a feeling that unless the guardians are cleared out, that teleport gate will never open again.
LanguageData.WotF_Site_Ruin_Core.description: An ancient engineering facility buried beneath overgrowth and concrete. The relics sealed deep within remain untouched, and the mechanisms guarding it are still active.
LanguageData.WotF_Site_Ruin_Core.label: ancient engineering ruin
